blocks.text_en: The e2eResult shall contain information: • e2eState: Status of the communication channel exchanging the data. Possible values are: VALID, DEINIT , NODA T A, INIT , INVALID if the state machine is en- abled (disableEndT oEndStateMachine = FALSE). If the state machine is disabled then e2eResult shall not contain a status information of the communication channel
